description: The OFF-SOURCE COST Action publishes a GeoPackage mapping offshore freshened groundwater and nearby infrastructure. Zenodo provides the file free under CC BY 4.0. Layers combine reported freshwater occurrences and volume estimates with desalination plants, oil and gas platforms, coastlines, water stress, withdrawals and seabed characteristics. The project estimates distances to infrastructure and shore, slope profiles and possible development constraints. These spatial inputs can inform water-supply and offshore-pipeline planning simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this combined feasibility map. Coverage brings together global and European source layers, not measured extraction rates at every candidate location. Source datasets retain their own rights and uncertainties. These feasibility scores are screening estimates, not proof of economic or environmental approval. No GeoPackage was downloaded or location calculation reproduced.
